{{Top|leg}}
'''Command control voice''' was a system of voice-pattern recognition used to control [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and could be utilized to input [[Command Control Instruction]]s. Prior to the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]], Captain [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] designated the Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] a command control voice for the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The princess used this authority to give R2-D2 instructions to safeguard the stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] and deliver them to General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on the surface of [[Tatooine/Legends|the planet]]. Artoo understood these instructions to be his "mission" and overcame numerous obstacles until they were fulfilled.<ref name="Black Knight">{{SWRadio|Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns}}</ref>
